filer_name.rationale: Filer name is a header-level field not represented as a leaf element in the IRS5471ScheduleG schema.

filer_identifying_number.rationale: Filer identifying number is a header-level field not represented as a leaf element in the IRS5471ScheduleG schema.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Annual accounting period begin date is a header-level field not represented as a leaf element in the IRS5471ScheduleG schema.

tax_year_end.rationale: Annual accounting period end date is a header-level field not represented as a leaf element in the IRS5471ScheduleG schema.

schg_foreign_government_shareholder.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 1 about a foreign government being a 5%+ shareholder.

schg_reorganization.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 2 about the foreign corporation being a party to a reorganization.

schg_shareholder_owned_through_fc.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 3 about U.S. shareholders owning stock through another foreign corporation.

schg_cost_sharing.rationale: FrgnCorpPartcpCostShrInd directly maps to whether the foreign corporation participated in a cost sharing arrangement (Schedule G question 4).

schg_subpart_f_withdrawn.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 5 about previously excluded Subpart F income withdrawn from investment.

schg_intangibles_related_party.rationale: IntangiblePropertyReceivedInd is the closest match to Schedule G question 6 about intangible-related amounts with related parties, though it may not capture all nuances.

schg_base_erosion_payments.rationale: BaseErosionPaymentBenefitInd maps to Schedule G question 7 about whether the foreign corporation made base erosion payments.

schg_dual_consolidated_loss.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 8 about dual consolidated losses.

schg_country_by_country_report.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 9 about country-by-country reporting requirements.

schg_section_965.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 10 about amounts included in gross income under section 965.

schg_hybrid_transactions.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 11 about hybrid transactions or arrangements.

schg_domestic_partnership_shareholder.rationale: No candidate element corresponds to Schedule G question 12 about domestic partnerships as U.S. shareholders.
